title: Why is the Axolotl's Regeneration So Unique?

scenes.label: Myth: Animal Regrowth
scenes.text: Most animals can regrow lost body parts

scenes.label: Axolotl Regeneration
scenes.text: Axolotls have a unique genetic makeup that allows them to regrow limbs, eyes, and parts of their brain

scenes.label: Regrow Spinal Cord
scenes.text: The axolotl's power to regrow its spinal cord is still not fully understood
